transcript.answer: Otto pull request #474. The Fallback Model Allowlist spec cites #474 for the statement that the provider block hands HAL Engine the resolved fallback as the only entry of `fallbackProviders`, the setting HAL Engine fails over through. Before that change, `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` was not passed to HAL Engine's failover. The same PR also refuses a `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` naming any row other than the mock until a fallback vendor is chosen (KU-07). It also refuses the mock as the fallback of a non-mock `MODEL_ID`. I did not see the PR itself, only the spec's citations of it.
